verdict.rationale: Highnote documents spend rules on dollar amount and authorization count, and velocity controls that add time windows (for example a $1,000 weekly limit). These rules apply at the card, account, or program level and are evaluated at authorization, so the platform enforces them rather than your code. missing for 10: explicit per-cardholder (rather than per-account) scoping, documented daily/monthly/all-time window options beyond the weekly example, an explicit count-based velocity example, independent or hands-on corroboration.
